before: A comment's text could not change after it was written: the only ways to correct it were to delete the thread or to add a reply.
after: setCommentText replaces the body of one comment or reply in one observed package transaction, keeping the comment's attributes, the paraId of its last paragraph, its thread state and its range markers. A collaboration session refuses it.
reason: The write emits existing node, attribute, child and text primitives on comments.xml, and the shared format does not change. Collaboration sessions refuse the edit until a two-replica test proves that it arrives whole, so participants cannot diverge on it.
